001: Hey Lucas, are you going to the theater club meeting tonight?
Yes, I'm going. Are you coming with us?
I can't, I have a piano lesson at the same time.
Oh, that's too bad. You should try to change your lesson.
It's complicated, but I'll ask the teacher.
Good idea. Let's keep each other posted.
002: Hugo, did you see the new schedule for the photo club?
Yes, they're organizing a trip to the park on Saturday.
That sounds great. Are you thinking of signing up?
I think so, I love taking pictures outdoors.
Me too, I'd like to come along.
003: Are you taking part in the ecology club's volunteer day?
I'm not sure yet. When exactly is it?
It's next weekend, we're going to clean up the river.
It would be great if you could come, we're short on people.
I'll confirm that tomorrow, I promise.
004: The debate club is looking for new members, did you know?
Yes, I saw the poster in the hallway.
Would you be interested in joining?
Maybe, but I'm a bit shy about speaking in public.
Don't worry, we start with small groups.
Okay, I'll come to the next session to see.
005: Did you enjoy the party organized by the music club?
Yes, it was really nice. The bands were good.
I loved the jazz concert, especially the saxophonist.
Me too, he was impressive. Do you know if they're playing again soon?
I think they're doing another concert next month.
We should go back together, then.
006: The cooking club is preparing a workshop on French pastries.
Oh really? When and where is it?
Thursday afternoon, in the activities room.
I'll try to go, I love cooking.
Great, we can taste our creations at the end.
007: Are you still part of the hiking club?
Yes, we went on a nice trip last Sunday.
How was it? Was the weather nice?
The weather was perfect, and the scenery was beautiful.
That makes me want to get into it too.
You should come on the next trip, you'll love it.
008: The film club is showing an old French movie on Friday.
Which one? Do you remember the title?
I think it's a New Wave film.
I'm really interested in that. Should we go together?
With pleasure, I'll book two seats.
009: Do you know how to join the robotics club?
You have to send an email to the president, I think.
Do you have his address? I can't find it on the website.
I'll send it to you by message in a bit.
Thanks, that's very kind of you.
No problem, I hope you'll like the club.
010: The language club is organizing an exchange with Spanish students.
That's a great opportunity to practice.
Are you planning to sign up for the exchange?
Yes, I'd really like to improve my Spanish.
Me too, we could sign up together.
Excellent idea, we'll fill out the forms tomorrow.
